facts.label: Said + could / couldn’t
facts.sub: Para contar o que alguém podia ou não podia fazer, use said + could ou couldn’t + verbo base: He said he could pay. He said he couldn’t come.

facts.label: Podia
facts.sub: Use said + could para contar o que alguém podia fazer: He said he could pay. She said she could help. Could vem antes do verbo base: could come, could pay, could help.

facts.label: Não podia
facts.sub: Use said + couldn’t para contar o que alguém não podia fazer: He said he couldn’t come. They said they couldn’t find it. Couldn’t também aparece em conversas por telefone e mensagem.

compare.br: No Brasil, dizemos “ele disse que não podia vir” e o verbo é simples.
compare.us: Em inglês, can vira could e can’t vira couldn’t: “He said he couldn’t come.” Não use to depois de could.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: Can becomes could in reported speech.
“I can’t come” becomes “He said he can’t come” after a past report.
items.why: Usually: He said he couldn’t come.

items.s: We say He said he could pay.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: Can becomes could in reported speech. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
“I can’t come” becomes “He said he can’t come” after a past report. → Falso (Usually: He said he couldn’t come.)
We say He said he could pay. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

pages.title: A phone store · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a hot Friday afternoon in a phone store in Dallas. The air conditioner hums above the door. Abe works behind a long glass counter. Theo walks in without his brother. Abe looks up with a friendly smile. He wants to know about the old phone.

“Theo, welcome back. Is your brother coming to get his phone?” says Abe. “He said he couldn’t come today because he was working.” says Theo. “No problem. He told me he couldn’t find the receipt either.” says Abe.
